entryCode is the ticket's QR code (FR-070), encrypted
and treated as a credential per SR-018. entryCodeHash is
a keyed hash, unique per event, so one ticket links to
one account (FR-084). A ticket is stored only once it is
matched: an import waiting for the typed code is kept in
Redis for 30 minutes, not here (FR-004, FR-083).

records the highest level already notified, so a warning
is notified once per level (FR-036, NFR-003).
